033/**
034 * Session for parsing HOCON format into POJOs.
035 */
036@SuppressWarnings({
037   "java:S110", // Inheritance depth acceptable for this class hierarchy.
038   "java:S135", // readArrayOrConcat uses two distinct breaks — one for standard HOCON terminators, one for unquoted keys after arrays/objects; merging them would obscure intent
039   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
040   "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for this specific logic.
041   "java:S6541", // Brain method acceptable for this parser state machine.
042   "resource", // Closeable resources are owned by the caller's parser session; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
043   "unchecked" // Type erasure on reflective/generic cast; element type is verified at call site.
044})
045public class HoconParserSession extends ReaderParserSession implements RecordReadable {
046
047   private static final String[] EMPTY_PATH = new String[0];
048

085   @Override /* RecordReadable */
086   public RecordReader readRecords(Object input) throws IOException {
087      return RecordAdapter.reader(this, input);

090   @Override /* RecordReadable */
091   public boolean isRecordStreaming() {

094
095   @Override
096   protected <T> T doRead(ParserPipe pipe, ClassMeta<T> type) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
097      String inputStr;
098      try {
099         inputStr = pipe.asString();
100      } catch (IOException e) {
101         throw new ParseException(e);
102      }
103      if (inputStr == null)
104         return null;
105      var trimmed = inputStr.trim();
106      if (trimmed.isEmpty())
107         return null;
108      var tokenizer = new HoconTokenizer(new StringReader(inputStr));
109      var root = readRoot(tokenizer);
110      if (root == null)
111         return null;
112      if (hoconParser.resolveSubstitutions) {
113         var resolver = new HoconResolver(root);
114         resolver.resolve();
115      }
116      var map = hoconToMap(root, type);
117      return (T) convertToBean(map, type);
118   }
119
120   private HoconValue.HoconObject readRoot(HoconTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
121      t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
122      var peek = t.peek();
123      if (peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.EOF)
124         return null;
125      if (peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.LBRACE) {
126         t.read();
127         return readObject(t, null, new String[0]);
128      }
129      return readRootBraceless(t);
130   }
131
132   private HoconValue.HoconObject readRootBraceless(HoconTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
133      var root = new HoconValue.HoconObject();
134      while (t.peek().type() != HoconTokenizer.TokenType.EOF) {
135         var path = readPath(t);
136         if (path == null || path.length == 0)
137            break;
138         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
139         var next = t.peek();
140         if (next.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.LBRACE) {
141            t.read();
142            var nested = readObject(t, root, path);
143            var existing = root.getPath(path);
144            if (existing instanceof HoconValue.HoconObject existingObj)
145               existingObj.merge(nested);
146            else
147               root.setPath(path, nested);
148         } else if (next.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.PLUS_EQUALS) {
149            t.read();
150            t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
151            var value = readValueOrConcat(t);
152            var existing = root.getPath(path);
153            if (existing instanceof HoconValue.HoconArray arr)
154               arr.add(value);
155            else {
156               var newArr = new HoconValue.HoconArray();
157               if (existing != null)
158                  newArr.add(existing);
159               newArr.add(value);
160               root.setPath(path, newArr);
161            }
162         } else if (next.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.EQUALS || next.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.COLON) {
163            t.read();
164            t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
165            var value = readValueOrConcat(t);
166            value = resolveSelfRefConcatIfNeeded(value, path, root);
167            root.setPath(path, value);
168         } else {
169            throw new ParseException(this, "Expected =, : or brace at line %s", t.getLine());
170         }
171         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
172         if (t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.NEWLINE)
173            t.read();
174      }
175      return root;
176   }
177
178   private String[] readPath(HoconTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
179      var tok = t.read();
180      String first = switch (tok.type()) {
181         case EOF -> null;
182         case UNQUOTED_STRING -> isTrimStrings() ? tok.stringValue().trim() : tok.stringValue();
183         case QUOTED_STRING, TRIPLE_QUOTED -> isTrimStrings() ? tok.stringValue().trim() : tok.stringValue();
184         case NULL -> null;
185         case TRUE -> "true";
186         case FALSE -> "false";
187         case NUMBER -> tok.numberValue().toString();
188         default -> throw new ParseException(this, "Expected key at line %s", t.getLine());
189      };
190      if (first == null)
191         return EMPTY_PATH;
192      var path = new ArrayList<String>();
193      if (tok.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.UNQUOTED_STRING && first.contains(".") && !first.startsWith("."))
194         path.addAll(Arrays.asList(first.split("\\.", -1)));
195      else {
196         var comp = first.startsWith(".") ? first.substring(1) : first;
197         if (!comp.isEmpty())
198            path.add(comp);
199         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
200         while (t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.UNQUOTED_STRING
201               || t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.QUOTED_STRING
202               || t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.TRIPLE_QUOTED) {
203            var next = t.read().stringValue();
204            var part = next.startsWith(".") ? next.substring(1) : next;
205            if (!part.isEmpty())
206               path.add(part);
207            t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
208         }
209      }
210      return path.toArray(String[]::new);
211   }
212
213   /**
214    * Parses a value, supporting HOCON concatenation: adjacent values on the same line
215    * are concatenated (strings) or merged (objects/arrays).
216    */
217   private HoconValue readValueOrConcat(HoconTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
218      var values = new ArrayList<HoconValue>();
219      values.add(readValue(t));
220      while (true) {
221         t.skipWhitespaceAndCommentsExceptNewlines();
222         var peek = t.peekNoSkip();
223         if (peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.NEWLINE
224               || peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.COMMA
225               || peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.RBRACE
226               || peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.RBRACKET
227               || peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.EQUALS
228               || peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.PLUS_EQUALS
229               || peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.EOF)
230            break;
231         // HOCON: newline ends concatenation; unquoted string after array/object is next key, not concat
232         var last = values.isEmpty() ? null : values.get(values.size() - 1);
233         if (peek.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.UNQUOTED_STRING
234               && (last instanceof HoconValue.HoconArray || last instanceof HoconValue.HoconObject))
235            break;
236         values.add(readValue(t));
237      }
238      if (values.size() == 1)
239         return values.get(0);
240      return combineConcat(values);
241   }
242
243   private static HoconValue combineConcat(List<HoconValue> values) {
244      if (values.size() == 1)
245         return values.get(0);
246      var allArrays = values.stream().allMatch(v -> v instanceof HoconValue.HoconArray);
247      var allObjects = values.stream().allMatch(v -> v instanceof HoconValue.HoconObject);
248      if (allArrays) {
249         var first = (HoconValue.HoconArray) values.get(0);
250         for (var i = 1; i < values.size(); i++)
251            first.concat((HoconValue.HoconArray) values.get(i));
252         return first;
253      }
254      if (allObjects) {
255         var first = (HoconValue.HoconObject) values.get(0);
256         for (var i = 1; i < values.size(); i++)
257            first.merge((HoconValue.HoconObject) values.get(i));
258         return first;
259      }
260      var concat = new HoconValue.HoconConcat();
261      for (var v : values)
262         concat.add(v);
263      return concat;
264   }
265
266   private static String[] concatenatePaths(String[] prefix, String[] path) {
267      var result = new String[prefix.length + path.length];
268      System.arraycopy(prefix, 0, result, 0, prefix.length);
269      System.arraycopy(path, 0, result, prefix.length, path.length);
270      return result;
271   }
272
273   private static HoconValue resolveSelfRefConcatIfNeeded(HoconValue value, String[] fullPath,
274         HoconValue.HoconObject root) throws ParseException {
275      if (!(value instanceof HoconValue.HoconConcat concat))
276         return value;
277      var pathStr = String.join(".", fullPath);
278      if (!concat.referencesPath(pathStr))
279         return value;
280      var existing = root.getPath(fullPath);
281      if (existing == null)
282         return value;
283      var resolver = new HoconResolver(root);
284      Function<String,HoconValue> lookup = p -> eq(p, pathStr) ? existing : resolver.lookup(p);
285      return resolver.resolveConcatWithLookup(concat, lookup);
286   }
287
288   private HoconValue readValue(HoconTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
289      var tok = t.peek();
290      return switch (tok.type()) {
291         case UNQUOTED_STRING, QUOTED_STRING, TRIPLE_QUOTED -> {
292            t.read();
293            var s = isTrimStrings() ? tok.stringValue().trim() : tok.stringValue();
294            yield new HoconValue.HoconString(s);
295         }
296         case NUMBER -> {
297            t.read();
298            yield new HoconValue.HoconNumber(tok.numberValue());
299         }
300         case TRUE -> {
301            t.read();
302            yield new HoconValue.HoconBoolean(true);
303         }
304         case FALSE -> {
305            t.read();
306            yield new HoconValue.HoconBoolean(false);
307         }
308         case NULL -> {
309            t.read();
310            yield new HoconValue.HoconNull();
311         }
312         case LBRACE -> {
313            t.read();
314            yield readObject(t, null, new String[0]);
315         }
316         case LBRACKET -> {
317            t.read();
318            yield readArray(t);
319         }
320         case SUBSTITUTION, OPT_SUBSTITUTION -> {
321            var st = t.read();
322            yield new HoconValue.HoconSubstitution(st.stringValue(), tok.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.OPT_SUBSTITUTION);
323         }
324         case EOF -> null;
325         default -> throw new ParseException(this, "Unexpected token %s at line %s", tok.type(), t.getLine());
326      };
327   }
328
329   private HoconValue.HoconObject readObject(HoconTokenizer t, HoconValue.HoconObject root, String[] pathPrefix)
330         throws IOException, ParseException {
331      enterParseDepth();
332      try {
333         return readObjectImpl(t, root, pathPrefix);
334      } finally {
335         exitParseDepth();
336      }
337   }
338
339   private HoconValue.HoconObject readObjectImpl(HoconTokenizer t, HoconValue.HoconObject root, String[] pathPrefix)
340         throws IOException, ParseException {
341      var obj = new HoconValue.HoconObject();
342      var effectiveRoot = or(root, obj);
343      t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
344      while (t.peek().type() != HoconTokenizer.TokenType.RBRACE && t.peek().type() != HoconTokenizer.TokenType.EOF) {
345         var path = readPath(t);
346         if (path == null || path.length == 0)
347            break;
348         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
349         var next = t.peek();
350         if (next.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.LBRACE) {
351            t.read();
352            var nested = readObject(t, effectiveRoot, concatenatePaths(pathPrefix, path));
353            var existing = obj.getPath(path);
354            if (existing instanceof HoconValue.HoconObject existingObj)
355               existingObj.merge(nested);
356            else
357               obj.setPath(path, nested);
358         } else if (next.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.PLUS_EQUALS) {
359            t.read();
360            t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
361            var value = readValueOrConcat(t);
362            var existing = obj.getPath(path);
363            if (existing instanceof HoconValue.HoconArray arr)
364               arr.add(value);
365            else {
366               var newArr = new HoconValue.HoconArray();
367               if (existing != null)
368                  newArr.add(existing);
369               newArr.add(value);
370               obj.setPath(path, newArr);
371            }
372         } else if (next.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.EQUALS || next.type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.COLON) {
373            t.read();
374            t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
375            var value = readValueOrConcat(t);
376            var fullPath = concatenatePaths(pathPrefix, path);
377            value = resolveSelfRefConcatIfNeeded(value, fullPath, effectiveRoot);
378            obj.setPath(path, value);
379         } else {
380            throw new ParseException(this, "Expected =, : or brace at line %s", t.getLine());
381         }
382         // skipWhitespaceAndComments is a no-op while a token is cached (see HoconTokenizer), so a
383         // closing `}` already peeked by readArrayOrConcat's concat loop is preserved here and the
384         // loop terminates naturally via the while-condition above rather than chewing through a
385         // newline that belongs to an enclosing scope.
386         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
387         if (t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.COMMA || t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.NEWLINE)
388            t.read();
389         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
390      }
391      if (t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.RBRACE)
392         t.read();
393      return obj;
394   }
395
396   private HoconValue.HoconArray readArray(HoconTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
397      enterParseDepth();
398      try {
399         return readArrayImpl(t);
400      } finally {
401         exitParseDepth();
402      }
403   }
404
405   private HoconValue.HoconArray readArrayImpl(HoconTokenizer t) throws IOException, ParseException {
406      var arr = new HoconValue.HoconArray();
407      t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
408      while (t.peek().type() != HoconTokenizer.TokenType.RBRACKET && t.peek().type() != HoconTokenizer.TokenType.EOF) {
409         // Elements inside [ ... ] are separated by COMMA or NEWLINE (handled below), so each
410         // readArrayOrConcat call returns a single element.  HOCON array-concatenation
411         // (`[a,b] [c,d]` ≡ `[a,b,c,d]`) is performed inside readArrayOrConcat when adjacent
412         // arrays appear without a separator; the result is already a flattened HoconArray at
413         // that point.  Here we must add the element as-is so nested arrays like
414         // `[[1,2,3], [4,5,6]]` (with separators) stay nested rather than flattening.
415         arr.add(readValueOrConcat(t));
416         // readArrayOrConcat's internal concat loop calls peekNoSkip(), which eagerly consumes the
417         // closing-bracket char from the underlying reader and stashes it as peeked=RBRACKET.
418         // skipWhitespaceAndComments is a no-op while a token is cached (see HoconTokenizer), so it
419         // will NOT read past the cached `]` and eat a following newline — a newline that is either
420         // the in-array separator for the NEXT element of an enclosing array or a meaningful boundary
421         // for an outer scope.  This prevents adjacent newline-separated inner arrays like
422         // `[[1,2]\n[3,4]]` from being silently re-merged via HOCON array-concatenation above us.
423         // The loop terminates on the cached `]` via the while-condition above.
424         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
425         if (t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.COMMA || t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.NEWLINE)
426            t.read();
427         t.skipWhitespaceAndComments();
428      }
429      if (t.peek().type() == HoconTokenizer.TokenType.RBRACKET)
430         t.read();
431      return arr;
432   }
433
434   private Object hoconToMap(HoconValue val, ClassMeta<?> type) throws ParseException {
435      enterParseDepth();
436      try {
437         return hoconToMapImpl(val, type);
438      } finally {
439         exitParseDepth();
440      }
441   }
442
443   private Object hoconToMapImpl(HoconValue val, ClassMeta<?> type) throws ParseException {
444      if (val == null)
445         return null;
446      // STRING values targeting byte[] consult the configured BinaryFormat's variant BinarySwap
447      // before falling back to the default String → byte[] UTF-8 coercion that the bean binder
448      // would otherwise apply at the collection-element / top-level dispatch site.  The
449      // bean-property path is unaffected because the per-property MPP install hides the type-level
450      // default swap behind the per-property swap on the BeanPropertyMeta.
451      //
452      // At BinaryFormat.NOT_SET BinarySwap.match returns 0 and no swap fires, but
453      // HoconSerializerSession emits byte[] at NOT_SET as a base64 string (to sidestep HOCON's
454      // array-concatenation flattening for nested int-array wire forms).  Decode that here as the
455      // symmetric fallback so List<byte[]> and top-level byte[] round-trip at NOT_SET.
456      if (val.getType() == HoconValue.Type.STRING && type != null && type.inner() == byte[].class) {
457         var s = ((HoconValue.HoconString) val).getValue();
458         var swap = type.getSwap(this);
459         if (swap != null)
460            return unswap(swap, s, type);
461         return Base64.getDecoder().decode(s);
462      }
463      // Look up bean property metas so nested typed-map properties (Map<K,V> with non-String K) can have
464      // their keys coerced via the converter's Map→Map path before the bean binds them.  Collection/Array
465      // property types are also surfaced here so the ARRAY branch can thread the parent's element type
466      // into recursion and the byte[] swap dispatch above can fire at the right depth.  Other property
467      // shapes (Optional, primitive, bean) still pass through as object() so the lazy-typed conversion
468      // path stays in place.
469      var beanMeta = (type != null && type.isBean()) ? type.getBeanMeta() : null;
470      var result = switch (val.getType()) {
471         case STRING -> ((HoconValue.HoconString) val).getValue();
472         case NUMBER -> ((HoconValue.HoconNumber) val).getValue();
473         case BOOLEAN -> ((HoconValue.HoconBoolean) val).getValue();
474         case NULL -> null;
475         case OBJECT -> {
476            var obj = (HoconValue.HoconObject) val;
477            var map = newGenericMap();
478            for (var e : obj.getMembers().entrySet()) {
479               var key = e.getKey();
480               ClassMeta<?> childType = object();
481               if (beanMeta != null && key != null && neq(key, getBeanTypePropertyName(type))) {
482                  var pMeta = beanMeta.getPropertyMeta(key);
483                  if (pMeta != null) {
484                     var cm = (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo();
485                     if (cm != null && (cm.isMap() || cm.isCollectionOrArray()))
486                        childType = cm;
487                  }
488               }
489               map.put(key, hoconToMap(e.getValue(), childType));
490            }
491            yield map;
492         }
493         case ARRAY -> {
494            var arr = (HoconValue.HoconArray) val;
495            var list = newGenericList();
496            var elType = (type != null && type.isCollectionOrArray()) ? coalesce(type.getElementType(), object()) : object();
497            for (var el : arr.getElements()) {
498               list.add(hoconToMap(el, elType));
499            }
500            yield list;
501         }
502         default -> null;
503      };
504      // If the enclosing target is a typed Map (e.g. Map<TestEnum,String>), coerce keys / values
505      // via the converter's findMapConversion so the bean property binder gets a properly-keyed map.
506      if (result instanceof Map<?,?> result2 && type != null && type.isMap()
507            && type.getKeyType() != null && !type.getKeyType().isObject())
508         return convertToMemberType(null, result2, type);
509      return result;
510   }
511
512   private Object convertToBean(Object map, ClassMeta<?> type) throws ExecutableException, ParseException {
513      if (map == null)
514         return null;
515      if (type == null)
516         type = object();
517      var casted = cast((MarshalledMap) map, null, type);
518      if (casted != map)
519         return casted;
520      if (!type.isObject()) {
521         var swap = type.getSwap(this);
522         if (nn(swap)) {
523            var sType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
524            var swapped = convertToMemberType(null, map, sType);
525            return unswap(swap, swapped, type);
526         }
527         var result = convertToMemberType(null, map, type);
528         if (type.isBean() && result != null)
529            injectAnnotations((MarshalledMap) map, result);
530         return result;
531      }
532      return map;
533   }
534
535   private void injectAnnotations(MarshalledMap map, Object bean) throws ExecutableException {
536      var bm = toBeanMap(bean);
537      for (var entry : map.entrySet()) {
538         var key = entry.getKey();
539         var pm = bm.getPropertyMeta(key);
540         var val = pm == null ? null : getBeanValueSafely(bm, key);
541         if (pm == null || val == null)
542            continue;
543         var cm = (ClassMeta<?>) pm.getBeanInfo();
544         if (cm.getNameProperty() != null)
545            setName(cm, val, key);
546         injectParentAnnotations(cm, val, entry.getValue(), bean);
547      }
548   }
549
550   /*
551    * Recursively injects @ParentProperty (and @NameProperty on map values / nested beans) into val.
552    * Intermediate collections and maps are transparent: a collection/map element's parent is
553    * parentBean (the nearest enclosing bean), skipping all intermediate containers.  This keeps HOCON
554    * consistent with the streaming parsers.
555    */
556   private void injectParentAnnotations(ClassMeta<?> cm, Object val, Object node, Object parentBean) throws ExecutableException {
557      if (val == null || cm == null)
558         return;
559      if (cm.getParentProperty() != null)
560         setParent(cm, val, parentBean);
561      if (cm.isCollectionOrArray()) {
562         var et = cm.getElementType();
563         if (et == null || et.isObject())
564            return;
565         var nodeList = node instanceof List<?> nl ? nl : null;
566         var i = 0;
567         for (var element : toIterable(val)) {
568            injectParentAnnotations(et, element, nodeList != null && i < nodeList.size() ? nodeList.get(i) : null, parentBean);
569            i++;
570         }
571      } else if (cm.isMap() && val instanceof Map<?,?> valMap) {
572         var vt = cm.getValueType();
573         if (vt == null || vt.isObject())
574            return;
575         var nodeMap = node instanceof Map<?,?> nm ? nm : null;
576         for (Map.Entry<?,?> e : valMap.entrySet()) {
577            if (vt.getNameProperty() != null)
578               setName(vt, e.getValue(), e.getKey());
579            injectParentAnnotations(vt, e.getValue(), nodeMap != null ? nodeMap.get(e.getKey()) : null, parentBean);
580         }
581      } else if (cm.isBean() && !(val instanceof Map) && node instanceof MarshalledMap nodeMap) {
582         injectAnnotations(nodeMap, val);
583      }
584   }
585
586   private static Iterable<?> toIterable(Object val) {
587      if (val instanceof Collection<?> c)
588         return c;
589      if (val instanceof Object[] a)
590         return Arrays.asList(a);
591      return List.of();
592   }
593
594   private static Object getBeanValueSafely(BeanMap<?> bm, String key) {
595      try {
596         return bm.get(key);
597      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
598         return null;
599      }
600   }
601}
